color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim as per Agent 1 rules. Light register: white page background (#ffffff), dark charcoal text (#2b2b29, #263d40), vivid burnt orange accent (#df5e12).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Font size scale shift ×1.15 (intensity 3). All heading sizes scaled up for commanding editorial presence. Body sizes unchanged. Three fonts: Playfair Display (headings), Open Sans (body), Raleway (edito/labels). All via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Delay introduction (intensity 3). 0.1s stagger delay added between sequenced animation items. Hero sequence: heading → subheading → CTA at 0.1s intervals. Card stagger groups use same 0.1s cadence. Base duration 0.48s ease-out preserved.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Container padding +12px (intensity 3). paddingLeft 24px → 36px, paddingRight 24px → 36px. More generous editorial margins. Container maxWidth set at 1200px. Full 12-column grid with 24px gutters.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Global scale factor ×1.35 (intensity 3). All numeric spacing values multiplied. Button padding 10px → 14px, container rowGap 44px → 59px, section padding 71px → 96px. Generous breathing room throughout.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist D: Hover opacity 0.75 (intensity 3). Added opacity: 0.75 to hover state for links, cards, and nav links. Buttons use opacity: 0.85 with subtle translateY(-1px) lift. Transition duration: 0.17s ease-in-out throughout. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Item spacing +10px (intensity 3). itemSpacing 54.5px → 64px. More spread nav links for editorial breathing room. Base: ochre-ledger geometry (86px height, 0.10em letter spacing, underline hover left-to-right). Position updated to fixed.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift. Added one paragraph to the hero analysis describing the physical material quality of the interface — the precision instrument character, the felt mass of card panels, the chamfered-edge quality of the rounded corners. concept_by_video.md generated fresh: scroll opening, hero ambient video, method sequence, studio interior — all with editorial motion direction language.
